title: Ankai Electric Bus Export Project in Nigeria
summary: Ankai pure electric buses were delivered to Nigeria, bringing a quiet, comfortable and green travel experience to local residents in West Africa.
content:
On May 12, 2026, a batch of brand-new Ankai pure electric buses stood fully prepared, about to travel far to Nigeria. The delivery of this batch of high-quality pure electric buses will change Nigeria's traditional travel landscape, bringing a quiet, comfortable and green brand-new travel experience to local residents, and adding a dazzling splash of China Red to the streets of West Africa from now on.

Currently, Nigeria is in a critical period of rapid urbanization and public transportation upgrading. Facing increasingly severe urban pollution and energy transition pressures, the local government is actively promoting green and low-carbon policies, strongly advocating the application of clean energy in the public transportation sector. However, the extreme climate of high temperature, humidity and abundant sandstorms, combined with complex road conditions, poses a nearly harsh challenge to the adaptability and durability of imported vehicles.

## Tailored for Local Operating Conditions

Aiming at this pain point, Ankai Bus conducted an in-depth investigation of local operating conditions and tailored the pure electric bus solution for this export. The vehicles adopt a monocoque body structure, featuring high overall strength and strong anti-torsion capability, showing no fear of long-term bumping on potholed roads. While substantially improving driving safety, it significantly extends the service life of the vehicles.

## High-Performance Powertrain

In terms of the powertrain system, the vehicles are equipped with high-performance, large-capacity CATL batteries, which possess both high energy density and ultra-long range, perfectly matching the high-intensity, long-hour operational needs of Nigerian urban transit. Meanwhile, the entire vehicle is equipped with a permanent magnet synchronous motor independently developed by Ankai, with specially optimized anti-condensation and anti-sand structures. It is not only powerful and responsive but also maintains high efficiency and energy saving under urban road conditions characterized by frequent starts and stops.
